title: Tech Note: Web Security 4D v11 SQL Component
author: Atanas Atanassov, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: On Web Authentication / On Web Connection database methods

historical_commentary.text: This note explained 4D v11 SQL's web request security model — On Web Authentication/On Web Connection hooks, Basic vs. Digest authentication, and 4D's built-in password system — and provided a component for building a custom security realm. The fundamental request-authentication hooks described are still present in 4D's classic web server today, so the concepts remain broadly applicable, but the overall approach reflects a page/URL-oriented classic web server model that has been complemented since by REST-based, token/session-oriented security for ORDA and REST APIs, which is the more common security model for modern 4D-built web/mobile clients.
related_updates: ORDA and 4D's REST server (4D v16 R5+, 2017) introduced a privileges/session-token based security model that is now the more common approach for modern API-driven 4D web and mobile clients

On Web Authentication/On Web Connection and HTTP Basic/Digest auth remain functional in 4D's classic web server for page-based scenarios, but are less central to security design than at the time of this note
